name: intentguard-bch-g0
description: Preseason SDK compatibility probes only; not a payment application

scripts.build: tsc && esbuild probes/browser-types.tsx --bundle --platform=browser --format=esm --outfile=dist/browser-probe.js && esbuild core/ui.ts --bundle --platform=browser --format=esm --outfile=dist/core/app.js && esbuild core/request-ui.ts --bundle --platform=browser --format=esm --outfile=dist/core/request.js
scripts.test: node --test dist/probes/sdk.test.js dist/preseason/xo/inspect.test.js preseason/xo/redact.test.mjs preseason/xo/http.test.mjs preseason/xo/cli.test.mjs preseason/xo/legacy.test.mjs dist/core/guard.test.js core/http.test.mjs dist/core/evidence.test.js dist/core/operation-store.test.js dist/core/electrum-transport.test.js dist/core/public-sources.test.js dist/core/review-coordinator.test.js dist/core/unsigned-builder.test.js dist/core/signed-verifier.test.js dist/core/presentation.test.js dist/core/payment-request.test.js dist/core/request-plan.test.js
scripts.validate: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test
